svg.aria-label: PDLC ontology pack loading and event processing flow

g.text: PDLC ontology pack: from YAML to graph
1. STARTUP — load the instructions
PDLC pack: pdlc.pack.yaml
Declares Change, pdlc.change.created, and the mapping rule.
Rule: repo + number identify a Change; title becomes a property.
Loader + shared Python models
ontology/loader.py reads YAML; domain/ontology.py defines its allowed shape.
The same pack models are used for PDLC and other packs.
OntologyRegistry
Composes and checks active packs; makes event rules available.
2. RUNTIME — process an event
Event arrives and is stored in the ledger
Example: pdlc.change.created, repo = acme/app, number = 7
Projection worker + PackProjector
worker/projection.py reads the event; domain/pack_projection.py
gets its rule from the registry and builds a graph-write plan.
Graph backend applies the plan
Create or update the Change for acme/app #7.
If work items are supplied, create IMPLEMENTS links to them.
Conditions: PDLC must be active; event admission and processing must succeed.
Payload-contract enforcement differs between bound and legacy ingestion paths.
